panels.title: Capacity: what the system can make, and makes, model by model
Capacity (tokens a second)
panels.description: What the system can make a second: each model's busiest minute in the last 7 days, added up. It grows as the models are used harder; a model not used this week counts nothing.

targets.expr: sum(max_over_time((sum by (model) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])))[7d:1m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Making now (tokens a second)
panels.description: Tokens every model makes a second now, added up (each llama.cpp slot counted).

targets.expr: sum((sum by (model) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Of capacity, now
panels.description: What is made now as a share of the capacity: room for more is the rest.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum((sum by (model) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])))) or vector(0)) / (sum(max_over_time((sum by (model) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])))[7d:1m])) > 0)

panels.title: Room now (tokens a second)
panels.description: The capacity not used now: how many more tokens a second the system could make at its busiest this week.

targets.expr: clamp_min(sum(max_over_time((sum by (model) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])))[7d:1m])) - (sum((sum by (model) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])))) or vector(0)), 0)

panels.title: Each model: tokens a second now, and the most it made (7 days)
panels.description: A line a model: what it makes a second now (solid), and its busiest minute in the last 7 days (dashed), its capacity as measured. The gap is its room.

targets.expr: (sum by (model) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])))

max_over_time((sum by (model) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])))[7d:1m])

panels.title: Throughput: the stack and a request (every engine)
Stack throughput (live)
panels.description: Tokens the whole stack generates a second now, every engine and model together (llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang). On llama.cpp each busy slot makes a token at each decode step, so this counts every slot; the decode steps alone (what this panel used to show) are one request's speed however many run at once. 0 when idle.

targets.expr: (sum(rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) * (1 + ((sum(rate(llamacpp:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total[5m])) / sum(rate(llamacpp:spec_decode_num_drafts_total[5m]))) > 0 or vector(0))) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Decode speed a request (5 min)
panels.description: How fast one answer streams: tokens over the time spent making them (not the prompt, not the wait), averaged over the requests of the last 5 minutes by their tokens, every engine. 'idle' when none answered.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_count[5m])) or vector(0))) / ((sum(rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_seconds_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm:request_decode_time_seconds_sum[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum[5m])) or vector(0))) >= 0

panels.title: Prefill speed a request (5 min)
panels.description: Prompt tokens read a second by a request, over the last 5 minutes (llama.cpp and vLLM). 'idle' when none did.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum[5m])) or vector(0))) / ((sum(rate(llamacpp:prompt_seconds_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds_sum[5m])) or vector(0))) >= 0

panels.title: Active requests
panels.description: Requests answering now, every engine together. Beyond a model's people at once, requests wait.

targets.expr: (sum(llamacpp:requests_processing) or vector(0)) + (sum(vllm:num_requests_running) or vector(0)) + (sum(sglang:num_running_reqs{tp_rank="0",priority=""}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Queued
panels.description: Requests waiting for room in an engine. Above 0 for long: more people at once than the models hold.

targets.expr: (sum(llamacpp:requests_deferred) or vector(0)) + (sum(vllm:num_requests_waiting) or vector(0)) + (sum(sglang:num_queue_reqs{tp_rank="0",priority=""}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Draft acceptance (5 min)
panels.description: Share of drafted tokens the model accepted (MTP or EAGLE), llama.cpp and vLLM. 'off' when no model drafts.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum(rate(llamacpp:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total[5m])) or vector(0))) / ((sum(rate(llamacpp:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total[5m])) or vector(0))) >= 0

panels.title: Tokens a second, by model (live and 5 min)
panels.description: A line a model: every token it generates a second, all its requests together, now (live) and over 5 minutes. One request's speed is beside, under Decode speed a request, by model.

targets.expr: (sum by (model) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])))
(sum by (model) (rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[5m])) or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[5m])) or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[5m])))

panels.title: Token volume (per window)
panels.description: Tokens counted per window, every engine. llama.cpp adds a request's tokens when it finishes, so a long answer is one bar at its end; vLLM and SGLang count them as they go.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(vllm:generation_tokens_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(sglang:generation_tokens_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))

(sum(increase(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(vllm:prompt_tokens_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(sglang:prompt_tokens_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))

(sum(increase(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(sglang:cached_tokens_total[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Prefix cache hit and MTP acceptance (%)
panels.description: Prefix cache hit: share of prompt tokens served from cache (a repeated system prompt or conversation history). MTP acceptance: share of draft tokens accepted. Both over finished requests, 5 min windows.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total[5m])) / (sum(rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total[5m])) + sum(rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total[5m]))) >= 0
100 * sum(rate(llamacpp:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total[5m])) / sum(rate(llamacpp:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total[5m])) >= 0

panels.title: Concurrency
panels.description: Requests answering now versus waiting for room, every engine together.

targets.expr: (sum(llamacpp:requests_processing) or vector(0)) + (sum(vllm:num_requests_running) or vector(0)) + (sum(sglang:num_running_reqs{tp_rank="0",priority=""}) or vector(0))
(sum(llamacpp:requests_deferred) or vector(0)) + (sum(vllm:num_requests_waiting) or vector(0)) + (sum(sglang:num_queue_reqs{tp_rank="0",priority=""}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Tokens a second, by model and its GPUs
panels.description: Tokens each model generates a second now, named with the GPUs its engine runs on (a vLLM or SGLang copy on its GPUs; a llama.cpp model on the GPUs it was given, 'all' for every one). Beside the GPU row below, it says which GPU's engine does the work.

targets.expr: sum by (model, gpus) (rate((llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode * llamacpp:n_decode_total)[1m:15s])) or sum by (model, gpus) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum by (model, gpus) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m]))

panels.title: Decode speed a request, by model (5 min)
panels.description: How fast one answer of each model streams: its tokens over the time it spent making them, over the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_seconds_total[5m])) >= 0 or sum by (model) (rate(vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate(vllm:request_decode_time_seconds_sum[5m])) >= 0 or sum by (model) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_count[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum[5m])) >= 0

panels.title: GPU utilisation
panels.description: When the model's experts run on the CPU (--n-cpu-moe), expect LOW GPU% during generation: the GPU idles between attention layers. That is the design, not a fault.

targets.expr: nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu_ratio * 100 * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

nvidia_smi_utilization_memory_ratio * 100 * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

panels.title: VRAM
panels.description: Headroom here is what --n-cpu-moe buys or spends. Running out mid-load is a CUDA OOM.

targets.expr: nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

nvidia_smi_memory_total_bytes * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

nvidia_smi_power_limit_watts * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

panels.description: A throttle line going to 1 while tok/s drops is your explanation.

targets.expr: nvidia_smi_clocks_current_sm_clock_hz / 1e6 * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_power_cap * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown * on (instance, uuid) group_left (gpu) (label_replace(label_join(count_values by (instance, uuid) ("gpu", nvidia_smi_index) * on (instance, uuid) group_left (name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info, "gpu", " ", "gpu", "name"), "gpu", "GPU $1 · $2", "gpu", "^([0-9]+) (?:NVIDIA )?(.+)$") and on (instance) count by (instance) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info) > 1 or on (instance, uuid) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

panels.title: CPU utilisation (total)
panels.description: When the model's experts run on the CPU (--n-cpu-moe), this should be HIGH during generation: the expert matmuls run here. If tok/s is low and this is low too, the engine is waiting on memory or disk, not compute.

targets.expr: 100 - (avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100)

panels.title: CPU per core
panels.description: One line per logical CPU, however many the machine has: the seven busiest, and the rest as their average. Shows whether -t is actually spreading work, and whether some cores (on a hybrid CPU, the efficiency cores) are dragging.

targets.expr: 100 - (avg by (cpu) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100)

panels.title: Memory: page cache is model residency
panels.description: The GGUF is mmap'd, so resident model weights show up as PAGE CACHE, not as used memory. Page cache collapsing means the model is being evicted and you will see tok/s fall with disk reads rising.

targets.expr: node_memory_MemTotal_bytes
node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes
node_memory_Cached_bytes

panels.title: Disk I/O — is the model paging?
panels.description: Per drive, as the machine names them. Sustained reads on the drive that holds the models DURING generation mean the working set does not fit and you are paging weights off disk. Brief reads at load are normal.

targets.expr: rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])
rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: Above the logical CPUs line, runnable work is queuing for the CPU.

targets.expr: node_load1
node_load5
node_load15
count(count by (cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total))

panels.title: CPU temperature: the hottest sensors
panels.description: Every CPU sensor: the seven hottest on average over the range keep a line each; the rest are one line, their average, with a faint band from the coolest to the hottest of them (the tooltip gives that range). Sustained CPU load can make the CPU throttle, which shows up as tok/s decay over a long run.

targets.expr: cpu_temperature_celsius

panels.title: NVMe temperature over time
panels.description: Each NVMe drive's composite temperature (SMART temp1) from node-exporter's hwmon collector, which reads the kernel's own nvme sensors -- node-exporter already mounts the host /sys, so no extra exporter is needed. A drive is named by its device, then the model it reports (node_nvme_info), as in nvme0 · <model>, or by its device alone when it reports no model. Some drives also report their NAND and controller as temp2/temp3, which the composite lags under sustained writes. SATA drives have no sensor here.

targets.expr: label_join(label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip=~"nvme_nvme[0-9]+",sensor="temp1"}, "device", "$1", "chip", "^nvme_(nvme[0-9]+)$") * on (instance, device) group_left (model) max by (instance, device, model) (node_nvme_info{model!=""}), "drive", " · ", "device", "model") or on (instance, chip) label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip=~"nvme_nvme[0-9]+",sensor="temp1"}, "drive", "$1", "chip", "^nvme_(nvme[0-9]+)$")

panels.title: Swap usage
panels.description: Swap being touched while the engine runs is a red flag: mmap'd model pages should be evicted from page cache instead. Growth here usually means something non-engine is under memory pressure.

targets.expr: node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes
node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes

panels.title: Token generation per model, in the time window
Tokens generated, by model
panels.description: Every answer the gateway booked, whichever engine served it, added up per model over the time window: the tokens it generated and its share of all, the window's average a second (the tokens over the window's seconds), the busiest minute, a request's decode speed (after its first token), the input read uncached and from the cache, and the median time to the first token.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model AS "Model", count(*) AS "Requests", COALESCE(sum(completion_tokens),0) AS "Tokens generated", round(100.0*COALESCE(sum(completion_tokens),0)/NULLIF(sum(sum(completion_tokens)) OVER (),0),1) AS "Share %", round((COALESCE(sum(completion_tokens),0)::numeric / GREATEST($__range_s,1)),2) AS "Tokens a second, the window", round((SELECT max(m.t) FROM (SELECT sum(r2.completion_tokens)/60.0 AS t FROM requests r2 WHERE r2.model = requests.model AND $__timeFilter(r2.started_at) AND r2.status <> 'refused' GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', r2.started_at)) m)::numeric,1) AS "Busiest minute, tokens a second", round((sum(completion_tokens - 1) FILTER (WHERE (completion_tokens > 1 AND first_token_at IS NOT NULL AND ended_at > first_token_at)) / NULLIF(sum(extract(epoch FROM (ended_at - first_token_at))) FILTER (WHERE (completion_tokens > 1 AND first_token_at IS NOT NULL AND ended_at > first_token_at)),0))::numeric,1) AS "Decode speed a request", COALESCE(sum(greatest(prompt_tokens - cached_tokens,0)),0) AS "Input, uncached", COALESCE(sum(cached_tokens),0) AS "Input, cached", round(COALESCE(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (first_token_at - started_at))),0)::numeric,2) AS "Median first token, s" FROM requests WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status <> 'refused' GROUP BY model ORDER BY "Tokens generated" DESC

panels.title: Tokens generated a second, by model
panels.description: Each model's generated tokens in a bucket over the bucket's seconds: what it sustained, summed over its copies and engines.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, $__interval), model AS metric, sum(completion_tokens) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "tokens a second" FROM requests WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status <> 'refused' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens generated, by model (each bucket)
panels.description: How many tokens each model generated in each bucket, stacked: the legend's Total is the window's.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, $__interval), model AS metric, sum(completion_tokens) AS "tokens" FROM requests WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status <> 'refused' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
